# 06.15 Roadmap: v0.7 VS Code Extension

## v0.7 VS Code Extension

Status: maintained in a separate repository. This core repository provides
source-positioned diagnostics, stable SVG rendering, and the HTTP/SSE preview
protocol through the shared native pipeline. The retained V1 WASM adapter is
not the V2 extension runtime.
